description: Get the profile of the authenticated user (the first seed user).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the authenticated user object; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single user by their user id.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single user by their username (case-insensitive).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the user object; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List a user's tweets, most recent first.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user whose tweets to list.

max_results.description: Maximum number of tweets to return (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list of tweets and a meta result_count; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the users that follow a given user.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user whose followers to list.

max_results.description: Maximum number of followers to return (default 100).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list of users and a meta result_count; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List the users that a given user is following.

user_id.description: The unique id of the user whose followings to list.

max_results.description: Maximum number of followed users to return (default 100).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list of users and a meta result_count; on failure (user not found), output contains an error message.

description: List tweets, either a specific set by ids or the most recent tweets.

ids.description: Optional list of tweet ids to fetch; when omitted, the most recent tweets are returned.

max_results.description: Maximum number of tweets to return when no ids are given (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list of tweets and a meta result_count; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single tweet by its id.

tweet_id.description: The unique id of the tweet.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the tweet object; on failure (tweet not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new tweet, optionally as a reply to another tweet.

text.description: The text content of the tweet.

author_id.description: Optional id of the authoring user; defaults to the authenticated user.

reply_to_tweet_id.description: Optional id of the tweet being replied to.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created tweet object; on failure (user or reply-target not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a tweet by its id.

tweet_id.description: The unique id of the tweet to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {deleted: true}; on failure (tweet not found), output contains an error message.

description: Search recent tweets whose text contains the query string (case-insensitive), most recent first.

query.description: The search query string matched against tweet text.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching tweets to return (default 10).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is an object with a data list of tweets and a meta result_count and query; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Like a tweet on behalf of a user (idempotent).

user_id.description: The id of the user liking the tweet.

tweet_id.description: The id of the tweet being liked.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {liked: true}; on failure (user or tweet not found), output contains an error message.

description: Retweet a tweet on behalf of a user (idempotent).

user_id.description: The id of the user retweeting.

tweet_id.description: The id of the tweet being retweeted.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is {retweeted: true}; on failure (user or tweet not found), output contains an error message.
